t: You're looking at the Old Fire Station on Renfrew Road in Kennington, a Grade Two listed former fire station. Two architects are credited with designing it. Robert Pearsall was architect to the London Fire Brigade and designed several notable stations, seven of them now Grade Two listed, including Woolwich in 1887. The other is Edward Cresy, an English architect and civil engineer who lived from 1792 to 1858.
